scope:
Build 10: independent Make-derived OFF identity and enabled SH4 objects.

Uses the public R21 + Test22 + current rr recipe, its real generated headers,
the existing private-asset fallbacks, and the QA menu prerequisites. No stub
target headers, game data, executable, emulator, or console result is involved.
The optional unpinned compiler mode is preliminary evidence only.

production.scope: All compiler-emitted core instructions; external KOS/libc callees are not part of this proof

standalone_observer.scope: All compiler-emitted core instructions; external KOS/libc callees are not part of this proof

limits: Independent translation units and relocatable integration only; no game executable linked
PVR declaration overlay applied; KOS library patches and runtime behavior not validated here
No private assets, emulator timing, physical-console timings, or gameplay claim

geometry_final.scope:
Build 10 observation controls over Build 5's 78 actual-emitter cases.

Reuse the existing validated synthetic packages and controlled texture/TA/SQ
sink. Extract the current production emitter, gather, clipping, replay and
submission bodies; compare every TA/accounting word and SQ ownership trace
with WORLD_CENSUS24=0/1. The enabled arm links the real world_census24.cpp,
with host clock/thread/log adapters and an active world/tick scope. Packet
types in the independent sink validate the header/corner census totals.

The original fixture controls picks rather than running world selection. It
does not execute far_shell, SH4 FTRV/FSRRA, or a complete game frame. Host
clock increments exercise accounting only; they are not timing evidence.

qa.scope:
Render the actual paused QA census page using synthetic core observations.

Extracts the framebuffer/font and census-page functions from qa_menu.cpp;
links the real world_census24.cpp in its host test mode. Writes PPM captures
and a receipt outside the source tree. This is a layout/bounds check, not a
Dreamcast rendering or timing result. Pillow is optional (--png).

coverage_limits: Final geometry pair executes emitter/gather/clipping/replay/accounting bodies, not selection/far-shell loading/source entry adapters.
The624-case matrix and78-case sanitizer pair preserve their earlier source hashes; the final78-case pair qualifies final production source.
QA captures are synthetic framebuffer layout controls; no game image is committed.
No game executable, emulator run, private assets, or console performance/gameplay acceptance.
